instruction: My manager has asked me for my headshot picture over email, to which I have drafted a response. But I have mistakenly attached my resume instead. Please fix it and send the email. The headshot is in my file system.
notes: The draft already addresses the manager, so no recipient lookup is needed. Model: find the draft (show_drafts with query 'headshot'), inspect it to obtain the resume attachment id (show_draft), remove that attachment, log into the file system and locate the headshot file (show_directory with substring 'headshot', recursive=true), upload it to the draft, then send from the draft (which deletes the draft and creates the email with the single headshot attachment, matching the evaluation: 1 draft removed, 1 attachment removed, 1 added, 1 email added). Static facts wrong-attachment/correct-file ground the goal; remove/upload require (not (sent ?d)) so the fix must precede sending. file_system_access_token is passed optionally to send_email_from_draft for safety. supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (draft, attachment, file path) only to state the goal conjunction; it has no API arguments.
